name: Vision and Light
desc: A given area may be lightly or heavily obscured. In a lightly obscured area — such as dim light, patchy fog, or moderate foliage — creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight. A heavily obscured area — darkness, opaque fog, dense foliage — blocks vision entirely, and a creature effectively suffers the blinded condition when trying to see into it. Bright light lets most creatures see normally; dim light (a lightly obscured area) creates a dim twilight; darkness is heavily obscured. Darkvision lets a creature treat darkness within its range as dim light.
